<thought>The 13C NMR shows two peaks in the aromatic region (≈143.9 ppm and 130.3 ppm). This pattern is consistent with a symmetric benzene ring (e.g., 1,3,5‑trisubstituted) where all six aromatic carbons give only two distinct signals. Therefore the molecule contains six aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
